events.name: 365 Elevator
events.description: You and a friend in a brushed-steel elevator: one waits on the right mouthing along to "365", the other walks in with a phone, turns, fixes their hair, and you both end side by side staring deadpan into the camera.

events.name: Ballon d'Or Prank
events.description: You're in the gala crowd in a black tuxedo when your name is called: you walk up the red-carpeted steps, take the golden ball trophy on stage and kiss it in front of a glittering gold curtain.

events.name: Boyfriend Makeup Prank
events.description: You talk to the camera bare-faced, then a hand gives you a full face of makeup step by step: sponge, concealer, contour, blush, eyeshadow, liner and false lashes, until you open your eyes wide in full glam and grin.

events.name: Come and Get It
events.description: A close phone selfie at night: you smile, wink and tip your head back as the picture flips between warm gold and black and white on every beat and red rose petals drift past your face.

events.name: Golf Dance
events.description: You at a floodlit driving range at night: you flick the driver up off the mat with your foot, hop and twirl it, swing it hard, spin round, then bounce into a little dance facing the camera with the club in your hand.

events.name: Hand of God
events.description: Two giant glowing golden hands reach in and take you by the hands, a flash turns your clothes to flowing white, and you're lifted high over a turquoise beach, through the clouds and into a golden heaven, then lifted again over a cruise ship and the islands.

events.name: Heaven Hug
events.description: You run through the clouds of heaven, see someone you miss waiting with white wings and a halo, sit down beside them on a white stone bench, feel their hand on your cheek and hold each other in one long hug.

events.name: Huss Huss Huss
events.description: You sit in the passenger seat of a car at sunset and lip-sync the Huss Huss Huss sound to your phone: "in this town everybody goes out partying except me", hands chopping at the lens on the HUSS beats, then counting off every party you're missing.

events.name: KDA Firestarter Dance
events.description: You dance the KDA Firestarter chorus full length at night, in front of a red-lit wall under a tree: the opening steps, a deep side lunge with arms swept wide, hands on the head, hair flips and arms crossed at the chest.

events.name: Love Handstand
events.description: You, in a plain white room with the letters LO and E on the wall, go up into a headstand in the gap between them, open your knees out into a V so the wall reads LOVE, then come over onto your feet, spin and finish with a high kick to the camera.

events.name: Opa Opa Opa
events.description: You and a friend on a lit city street at night, passing one phone back and forth in a bouncy handheld selfie, your hair flying up and flopping back on every "opa" of the song until you both squeeze into the frame laughing.

events.name: Snowman Bestie
events.description: You take a close-up selfie in a snowy pine forest, cheek to cheek with a big goofy snowman in black sunglasses, a striped pom-pom beanie and a striped scarf, its tongue out: you pout, it winks, you laugh and throw a peace sign, and it leans its snowy head in next to yours.

events.name: Yes Yes I Love You
events.description: You two walking away arm in arm down a lamp-lit old-town alley at night, until one scoops the other up and carries them on down the street, the long brown dress swinging out: the Yes Yes I Love You couple reel, with your faces.
